dsm.note: Model heights on the free 30 m Copernicus terrain, scored against the LiDAR surface. About 2 m of this comes from that terrain model, which is 3.64 m MAE off on its own, not from the height model.

dsm.name: DSM on LiDAR terrain
dsm.note: The ceiling: the same predicted heights on surveyed ground, so the error left is the model's alone. r is the median per scene.

rendering.label: Stability

rendering.label: Visual fidelity

rendering.label: Deployment
rendering.note: Standalone web app; five precomputed scenes open in seconds with no GPU at all

footnote: Swiss scenes: swisstopo swissSURFACE3D and swissALTI3D airborne LiDAR, a country and sensor the model never saw, scored through the live service (scene MAE 1.00 to 2.85 m). GAMUS strata: test tiles never trained on, from US cities that were, one centre crop per tile. Reproduce the Swiss figures with scripts/evaluate_live.py.
